jei.scp_unleashed.assembling.slower: Slower when the network can't supply enough power
jei.scp_unleashed.vending.snack: Sold by the Vending Machine for %s iron nuggets (button %s). It cannot be crafted.
jei.scp_unleashed.vending.machine: Pay with iron nuggets: right-click the machine with them or drop them in the coin slot. Pick a product, watch it drop, then take it from the tray. Keeps up to %s nuggets of credit; press return for change.
jei.scp_unleashed.fusion_reactor.fuel: 1 unit lasts %s min at full output
jei.scp_unleashed.fusion_reactor.info.ov: The Fusion Reactor is a 7x5x3 tokamak placed from a single item. It burns reactive material (made by irradiating energum dust in a fission reactor) together with water, needs no cooling and leaves no waste.
jei.scp_unleashed.fusion_reactor.info.st: Press START in its screen, then feed %s SP into the input terminal (the side cabinet with the green bolt). Only outlets mounted on that terminal can charge it. When the capacitor is full and fuel and water are loaded, the plasma ignites.
jei.scp_unleashed.fusion_reactor.info.fu: Put reactive material in the fuel slot. Each unit lasts %s minutes at full output and longer at partial load. When the last unit burns out the reactor shuts down and needs a new startup.
jei.scp_unleashed.fusion_reactor.info.wa: Pipe water into the inlet at the back with pressure pipes. It uses %s mB/t at full output and holds a 16 bucket buffer. If the water runs out the reactor shuts down and needs a new startup.
jei.scp_unleashed.fusion_reactor.info.ou: Power leaves only through the output terminal (orange bolt), up to %s SP/t. Mount Advanced Outlets on it: each carries 12,000 SP/t and each Ultimate Wire 8,000 SP/t, so full output needs two outlets with two Ultimate Wires each, or three outlets with one each. The reactor never pushes more than the mounted outlets and wires are rated for.
jei.scp_unleashed.fusion_reactor.info.cl: Fusion makes no waste and the reactor cannot overheat or melt down.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.fission_heat_exch: Place heat exchangers under a fission reactor's footprint and pipe water into any of them; all exchangers under one reactor share their water.

They only cool while water flows in, and the water they boil leaves as steam through vent ducts on their sides or bottom. A vibration chamber can turn the reactor's waste water back into clean water for them.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.waste_water: A byproduct of the fission reactor. It poisons whoever swims in it. Clean it with a vibration chamber.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.gas_dissolver.1: Connect a gas dissolver to a reactor's pressurized vent ducts through its top or bottom, or set it directly under a fuel tower, and keep it supplied with water by pipe or bucket. Gas that reaches it is destroyed, costing %s mB of water per unit, instead of escaping from open duct ends.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.gas_dissolver.2: It also slowly scrubs toxic gas clouds within %s blocks, so it cleans up leaks and meltdown fallout. It needs no power.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.warhead_alpha.1: The Alpha Warhead is the facility's self-destruct device. Place it, then arm it from an Alpha Warhead Detonation Panel within 128 blocks in the same dimension.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.warhead_alpha.2: Its lamps show its state: green when idle, amber when armed, flashing red during the 90-second countdown and fast red in the final ten seconds, when it can no longer be stopped. It cannot be broken while a countdown runs.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.warhead_alpha.3: On detonation every living thing within 100 blocks dies; creative and spectator players and armour stands are spared. The warhead itself is consumed.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.warhead_alpha.4: With mobGriefing on, the blast carves a crater about 64 blocks wide, spreading out from the warhead over a few seconds, with a scorched lining, a raised rim and flung debris, and with doFireTick on it starts fires. Unbreakable blocks and blocks with a blast resistance of 1200 or more survive.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.warhead_panel.1: Controls every Alpha Warhead within 128 blocks. Use the controls on its face directly.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.warhead_panel.2: Sequence: swipe an Omni keycard in the reader on the left, throw the arming lever up, lift the hazard-striped cover and press the red button. A wrong or missing card is refused.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.warhead_panel.3: The countdown lasts 90 seconds, with sirens, announcements and red alert lights. The yellow abort button cancels it until the last 10 seconds; after a cancel the panel reseals and needs the keycard again.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.warhead_panel.4: While counting down the panel gives a redstone signal on every side, and a comparator reads the time left, from 15 at the start down to 1.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.storage_container: A steel containment locker for one catalogued anomaly. It faces you when placed, like a chest.
Right-click to swing the heavy door open or shut. With the door open, sneak + right-click the door with an accepted anomaly to put it in, or with an empty hand to take it out.
Right-click with any glass block or glass pane to fit a glass front, so the contents can be seen with the door shut. Stained glass tints it.
Right-click with a Heated or Cold Storage Upgrade to condition the interior. A screwdriver takes the upgrade back out; sneak with the screwdriver to remove the glass.
Breaking it drops the container, its contents, the glass and any upgrade. A comparator reads 15 while something is stored inside.
A two-block version of the Storage Container for larger anomalous objects, with a tall display column inside.
It works exactly like the small container: one catalogued anomaly, a hinged door, an optional glass front and one environment upgrade.
It needs two blocks of clear space. Break either half to pick it up.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.heated_storage_up: Fits a heating element into a Storage Container. The interior glows orange and embers drift out when the door opens.
Right-click a container to install it. A container holds one environment upgrade; installing a Cold Storage Upgrade swaps them and returns this one.
Some anomalies only stay stable when they are kept warm.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.cold_storage_upgr: Fits a refrigeration coil into a Storage Container. The interior and the glass frost over, and cold mist spills out when the door opens.
Right-click a container to install it. A container holds one environment upgrade; installing a Heated Storage Upgrade swaps them and returns this one.
Some anomalies only stay stable when they are kept below freezing.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.sealed_case.1: A heavy locked case for moving dangerous anomalies. Whatever is sealed inside is held completely inert and cannot affect the carrier or anyone nearby.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.sealed_case.2: Right-click to unlatch it and take the contents into your inventory; they drop at your feet if it is full. Sneak and right-click with the case in one hand and an item in the other to seal that item inside.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.sealed_case.3: The case is fireproof and holds one stack. Anomalies handed over by the stranger arrive sealed in one.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.lab_vial.1: A glass sample vial. It is sealed when made, and a sealed vial is completely inert whatever it holds.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.lab_vial.2: Sneak and use it to break the seal, or stand it in a test tube holder and unseal it there, where it can be resealed.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.lab_vial.3: An open vial of a live culture exposes anyone within %s blocks with a clear line of sight: in a rack, in a pocket or on the floor.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.lab_vial_open.1: An open vial. Use it on an empty petri dish to pour its sample in; the vial is left empty and open. Vials can't be swabbed.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.lab_vial_open.2: Viral Storage keeps open vials safe only while it is cold and closed.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.lab_swab.1: A single-use sterile swab. Use it on a player, a mob or any block, or sneak and use it to swab yourself.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.lab_swab.2: A swab records every agent present on the subject at that moment, along with who and when. The result stays sealed until an analyzer reads it.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.lab_swab.3: Used on a petri dish with a live culture, it takes a labelled copy and the dish keeps growing. Vials can't be swabbed; pour them into a dish first.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.lab_result_slip.1: A printed assay slip. It names the subject, when the sample was taken and every agent the analyzer found.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.lab_petri_dish.1: A glass dish of agar. Pour in an open vial or streak a labelled swab to start a culture.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.lab_petri_dish.2: A dish holding a live culture exposes anyone within %s blocks with a clear line of sight. Solid blocks stop it.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.lab_petri_dish.3: Sneak and use the dish with an empty hand to sterilise it again.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.lab_tube_holder.1: Stands %s vials upright. Each slot is aimed at separately, numbered from the left as you face it.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.lab_tube_holder.2: Sneak with an empty hand to unseal or reseal the aimed vial.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.lab_tube_holder.3: A labelled swab used on an empty vial standing in a slot copies its sample into that vial and is spent.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.lab_viral_storage: A chilled locker holding %s vials of any kind. Use it to swing the lid open, use it again to reach the rack, and sneak and use it to shut the lid. While the lid is shut, sneaking places blocks against it as normal.
While it holds a vial it draws %s SP/t; empty, it draws nothing. Power it from an outlet on the junction box at its back.
With the lid open and power on, it breathes cold mist. With the lid open and no power, every live culture inside vents and exposes anyone within %s blocks until the lid is shut or power returns.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.lab_analyzer.1: A powered assay bench. It draws %s SP/t only while culturing, nothing otherwise, and takes about %s seconds a cycle.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.lab_analyzer.2: Insert a used swab. It lists every anomalous agent found, or reports the sample clean, and prints a slip.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.lab_analyzer.3: Anyone nearby hears the summary. The last result stays on its screen until the next assay prints.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.storage_container: Containers only take catalogued anomalies: %s. Anything else is refused at the door.
Containers only take catalogued anomalies. Anything else is refused at the door.
The Database is a site-wide archive. Every Database and Database Terminal in the world shows the same records to every player.
Use an opened dossier on it to file that document. You keep the folder, and each document only needs filing once.
Right-click with an empty hand to browse. PRINT gives you a Database Copy as many times as you like; READ opens the file on screen.

Use a folder on it again once it is filed and it is shredded instead of burnt; sneak-use files a new dossier and shreds it in one go. Shredding a sealed one-of-a-kind dossier returns its document to the Archive's draw.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.archive_database_: A smaller read-only screen for The Database. Browse, print and read every filed document from here.
It can't file documents. Use a Database Copy on it to put the copy back.
A printed copy of a filed dossier. It reads exactly like the original.
Copies never start an investigation and can't be filed again. Use one on a Database or terminal to put it back.
jei.scp_unleashed.gas.toxic: Toxic: poisons anyone without a gas mask
jei.scp_unleashed.info.gas_tank.1: Stores up to %s mB of a single gas. Vent ducts on its left side or top fill it; ducts on its right side or bottom draw from it, so the network needs a vent pressurizer.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.gas_tank.2: The window shows how full it is. A tank never releases gas through open vent ends by itself, but breaking it lets everything out.
Boils liquid into gas: water becomes steam and waste water becomes toxic gas. It draws %s SP/t while boiling and nothing when idle.
The gas leaves through a pressurized vent duct on top into tanks, dissolvers or other machines, or escapes through open vent ends. Its buffer holds %s mB; when that is full it stops.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.drain.1: Set a drain into a ceiling and pipe liquid into it: it rains the liquid out of its underside, up to %s mB per second. Open pipe ends never let liquid out, so a drain is how you get rid of it.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.drain.2: Anything standing up to %s blocks below gets drenched. Water puts out fires and rinses off dirt; waste water scalds; lava sets things alight.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.gas.steam: Steam comes from the Coolant Towers and Steam Channels of a fission reactor and from liquid vaporizers boiling water. Released into the open it just drifts away as white clouds.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.gas.toxic_gas: Toxic gas comes from reacting fuel towers and from vaporized waste water. Released into the open it forms poisonous clouds; a gas dissolver destroys it.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.lab_swab.4: A labelled swab copies its sample into an empty vial: hold the vial in your other hand and use the swab, or use the swab on an empty vial standing in a test tube holder. The vial keeps its seal, and the swab is spent.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.lab_tube_holder.4: An open culture standing in the rack exposes anyone within %s blocks.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.sealed_case.4: Right-click a Storage Container with a loaded case to pass the contents straight inside, so nobody ever holds them. The container's usual rules apply: if it refuses the item or is already full, nothing moves. Sneak and right-click a container with an empty case to seal its contents back inside.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.lab_petri_dish.4: Use a sterile swab on a live culture to take a labelled copy. It is the only way to copy a culture: streak the copy onto another dish or fill an empty vial with it.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.stasis_pod.1: A containment vessel charged with a %s. Right-click a living mob to seal it inside, then right-click a block to let it out again.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.stasis_pod.2: Its stasis field lasts %s in total and only drains while something is inside. Released mobs keep their health, effects, name, gear and data, and the pod keeps whatever time is left.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.stasis_pod.3: When the field runs out the mob breaks free on the spot and the pod shatters. In a chest or similar container it bursts out the next time someone opens it, breaking the container open.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.stasis_pod.4: Players, bosses and bound anomalies resist stasis, as do mobs that someone is riding or controlling.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.stasis_pod.upgrad: Combine an empty pod with a %s to raise it one tier with a fresh field.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.stasis_pod.top: Abyssal pods are the highest tier.
jei.scp_unleashed.dclass_blood: Cloning stock made from fresh meat and an empty lab vial. Any raw beef, pork, mutton, chicken or rabbit works.
jei.scp_unleashed.dclass_blood.use: Load it into a Cloning Machine. The empty vial comes back out of the tray.
jei.scp_unleashed.cloning_machine: A two-block growth tank. Feed it D-Class Blood and power, and a new D-Class grows inside the glass.
jei.scp_unleashed.cloning_machine.power: It draws %s power per tick only while growing. One subject takes %s seconds at full power; less power means slower growth.
jei.scp_unleashed.cloning_machine.releas: When the subject is grown the front opens and it steps out. Keep the two blocks in front clear.
jei.scp_unleashed.blank_personnel_file: Use on a D-Class to assign an ID and file its record. Read the filed copy for its disposition, conviction, scores and status.
jei.scp_unleashed.controller: Right-click a controllable body to take it over. Your own body stays behind, vacant, and your belongings stay safely with it.
jei.scp_unleashed.controller.release: Press %s to return. The body you leave keeps everything it carried.
jei.scp_unleashed.controller.death: If the controlled body dies it drops everything and you are pulled back to your own body.
jei.scp_unleashed.dclass: D-Class personnel wander, sleep at night, eat from their own pockets and pick things up. Sneak-use with an empty hand to see their inventory.
jei.scp_unleashed.dclass.care: Anything that afflicts a player afflicts them, and they always drop everything when they die.
jei.scp_unleashed.arsenic: Feed it to a Theodore, or drop it near some: the nearest Theodore runs over and eats it.
jei.scp_unleashed.arsenic.clones: The one who ate it splits off a clone every 1.5 to 2.5 seconds. At %s they huddle together and merge into an amalgamation that hunts players.
jei.scp_unleashed.arsenic.caps: At most %s Theodores and %s amalgamations per dimension. Kill the one who ate it and the cloning stops.
jei.scp_unleashed.theodore_blood: Load it into a Cloning Machine to grow a Theodore.
jei.scp_unleashed.theodore: Theodore wears MTF gear and wanders about doing nothing in particular.
jei.scp_unleashed.theodore.refuses: He has no neural interface, so the controller does nothing to him.
jei.scp_unleashed.theodore_amalgamation: Sixteen Theodores fused into one mass three blocks tall. It hunts players in survival and adventure mode.
Up close it slams the ground, hurting and slowing everything nearby. It drops flesh, bone, scrap metal and its dog tags.
jei.scp_unleashed.theodore_dog_tags: Dropped by a Theodore Amalgamation killed by a player.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.anti_memetic_pill: A small amber bottle holding %s pills. Hold use to take one. The bottle is used up with the last pill.
Each pill grants Anti-Memetic for %s minutes. While it lasts, certain memetic and antimemetic effects cannot take hold of you. Another pill restarts the timer instead of adding to it.
Taking another in the first %s minute of a dose brings a short bout of nausea. There are no other side effects.
It does not protect against everything. Some anomalies ignore it entirely, and finding out which is part of the job.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.marksman_revolver: A red revolver, refitted from a standard revolver at the Gun Bench. It handles exactly like the standard revolver and loads the same handgun rounds.
Press %s to flip a gold coin into the air. It carries %s coins, and each spent coin recharges in %s seconds.
Shoot a coin while it is airborne and the bullet ricochets off it into the closest threat in sight, always hitting for x%s damage.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.ultralaser.1: The Modulated Ion Kinetic Ultralaser is assembled at the Gun Bench from a Particle Disruptor, sixteen Meteoric Plates, a spare Disruptor Core, superconductors, energum alloy and two Severe Unstable Fragments.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.ultralaser.2: Hold attack to prime it. The cannon plays its jingle, counts in and fires after %s seconds. Let go, switch items or take a heavy hit and it powers down without spending the cell.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.ultralaser.3: The beam deals %s damage to every creature along a %s block line and throws survivors back. It stops at the first solid block and never breaks terrain.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.ultralaser.4: Every shot spends one Ultralaser Cell and leaves the cannon venting heat for %s seconds. Load cells with the gun reload key.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.ultralaser.5: It is heavy: you walk slowly while it primes, use aims it, and it kicks hard when it fires.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.ultralaser_cell.1: The only ammunition the Modulated Ion Kinetic Ultralaser accepts. One cell powers exactly one shot.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.ultralaser_cell.2: Cells are built at the Gun Bench around an unstable fragment: a Severe fragment makes one cell, an Abyssal fragment makes three.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.ultralaser_cell.3: Cells stack to %s. Keep them in your inventory and press the reload key with the cannon in hand.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.advanced_material: A powered fabrication bench for advanced materials. Load the ingredients into its four input slots; it works while it has power.
Draws %s SP/t at its standard rate; some recipes draw more. It takes Speed Upgrades.
Dense steel wound with charged copper: heavy, blast-resistant and faintly humming. Some anomalous matter cannot pass through it.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.magnetized_bulkhe: A heavy 2x2 bulkhead door of magnetized steel. It opens only while it receives a redstone signal and seals again when the signal stops.
Closed, its leaves clamp against charged contacts in the frame.
jei.scp_unleashed.advanced_materials.slo: Slower when the network can't supply enough power
jei.scp_unleashed.info.computer.1: A desktop terminal running SCP-OS. It only runs while its network powers it; wire an outlet to either side.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.computer.2: It draws %s power while running. Right-click it to use it.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.computer.3: Chat needs a Chat Server on the network. The NETWORK channel reaches every terminal but is never saved; each Message Database adds a stored channel.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.computer.4: Files holds up to %s files: copies of dossiers read from a Network Upload Port or saved from chat, and plain notes. Floppy discs carry files between networks.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.computer.5: Documents lists every dossier filed in The Database once The Database is wired into the same powered network. Reading a copy never starts an investigation.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.computer.6: Redstone and Sounds drive ports like transmitters and the sound console. The Scheduler runs ON and OFF steps by hand, at a time of day, on a timer, after a delay or from a redstone port.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.chat_server.1: Lets computers on the same network chat. Without one, the Chat app stays offline.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.chat_server.2: It draws %s power. The NETWORK channel only keeps a short buffer of recent messages for terminals that open chat late.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.chat_server.3: Network routers carry chat between networks like any other data.
Each powered Message Database adds a named channel to every computer on its network.
It stores the last %s messages of its channel and draws %s power. Right-click it to rename the channel or clear its log.
Breaking it keeps the channel and its messages on the item.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.network_upload_po: Insert an opened dossier or a floppy disc. Every computer on the network sees it as a drive in Files.
Dossiers can only be read; floppy discs can be written to and erased from a computer. Sealed folders are refused.
It draws %s power. Wire an outlet to its back.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.floppy_disc.1: Holds up to %s files. Its label fills in once something is written to it.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.floppy_disc.2: Insert it into a Network Upload Port to read or write it from any computer on that network.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.daevite_knight_sp: A Daevite Knight: a warrior of the reborn Daevite host in red lacquered plate, armed with either a long spear or a broad sword.
Spear-bearers strike from beyond sword reach and charge across open ground. Blade-sworn knights press in with chained cuts and turn blows aside with their guard.
They hunt anyone who is not of the host, villagers and their golems included, and they seldom fight alone.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.daevite_overseer_: A Daevite Overseer: a masked caster in crimson robes that drifts above the ground and never touches it.
Overseers keep their distance, hurl crimson bolts, mark the ground beneath their foes and lash out with embers when cornered. Their light mends the wounds of their kin.
Where overseers gather around an altar, something is being called.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.daevite_decor.fou: Found only in Daevite war camps and temples. It cannot be crafted.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.daevite_war_banne: A crimson standard of the Daevite host, stitched with a golden sigil and hung from a brass crossbar.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.daevite_brazier.1: A tall brass brazier heaped with coals that never quite go out. A shovel or water puts it out; flint and steel brings it back.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.daevite_idol.1: A small golden idol of a crowned figure with six arms, set on a basalt plinth.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.daevite_rug.1: A thick crimson rug bordered in gold thread, laid on the floors of Daevite tents.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.daevite_tent_clot: Heavy crimson canvas with gold-stitched seams, cut from a Daevite war tent.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.daevite_weapon_ra: A dark wooden rack holding two leaf-bladed spears and a broad sword. None of them can be taken down.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.daevite_lantern.1: A brass lantern glazed with crimson panes. It can stand on a surface or hang beneath one.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.daevite_brass_urn: A tall brass urn banded with crimson enamel and fine gold chevrons.
A wooden war drum with a painted hide head. Strike it and it still carries a beat.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.daevite_sigil_sto: Polished basalt with a brass band and a golden sigil inlaid in its face.
A crimson wall hanging of the six-armed god, worked in gold thread. It must hang against a wall.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.daevite_altar.1: A basalt altar with a brass bowl of embers. Daevite temples are built around one.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.daevite_relic_bli: Found only in the greatest Daevite ruins, near the end of the chronicle.
A burned relic with one weak spell. It cannot be repaired, and the more worn it is, the less it can be trusted.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.daevite_relic_bra: Found in Daevite ruins of every age, in caches, offerings and buried in the sand.
A relic of the Daevite empire. Foundation storage containers will catalogue it.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.daevite_relic_emb: Found in Daevite ruins from the first conquests onwards, more often in the later and deeper ones.
A burned relic with one weak spell. It cannot be repaired, and the more worn it is, the less it can be trusted.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.daevite_relic_fla: Found in Daevite ruins from the middle of the chronicle onwards, more often in the later and deeper ones.
A burned relic with one weak spell. It cannot be repaired, and the more worn it is, the less it can be trusted.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.daevite_relic_ido: Found in the later Daevite ruins, more often the closer the chronicle comes to its end.
A relic of the Daevite empire. Foundation storage containers will catalogue it.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.daevite_relic_sco: Found in Daevite ruins of every age, more often in the later ones.
A relic of the Daevite empire. Foundation storage containers will catalogue it.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.daevite_relic_spe: Found in Daevite ruins and carried by the dead who guard them.
It reaches a little further than a sword and can be thrown. It cannot be repaired with any material.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.daevite_relic_swo: Found in Daevite ruins and carried by the dead who guard them.
A light, quick blade with little durability left. It cannot be repaired with any material.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.daevite_relic_war: Found in the larger Daevite ruins, more often in the later and deeper ones.
A burned relic with one weak spell. It cannot be repaired, and the more worn it is, the less it can be trusted.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.daevite_robe_hood: Found in Daevite ruin caches and worn by the dead who guard them.
Light cloth armour. It can be mended with red wool.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.daevite_robe_sand: Found in Daevite ruin caches and worn by the dead who guard them.
Light cloth armour. It can be mended with red wool.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.daevite_robe_sash: Found in Daevite ruin caches and worn by the dead who guard them.
Light cloth armour. It can be mended with red wool.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.daevite_robe_vest: Found in Daevite ruin caches and worn by the dead who guard them.
Light cloth armour. It can be mended with red wool.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.daevite_ruin_deco: Decorations salvaged from the Daevite ruins that rise as SCP-140's pages fill. None of them can be crafted; mine them from the ruins to keep them.
Braziers can be lit with flint and steel or a fire charge, and put out with a shovel. Banners need something to hang from.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.daevite_god_crown: The golden crown of the Daevite god-king, left behind when he crumbles into ash and red light.
Worn as a helmet it gives %s armour. Fire and blasts cannot destroy it.
Storage containers display it on a red cushion.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.daevite_god_spawn: Calls the Daevite god without a ritual.
Only one god walks a world at a time. If it already walks, it answers in person instead.
It is not one battle but two, and it does not forgive mistakes.
When it falls, everything that serves it falls too.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.facility_tablet.1: A handheld guide to the facility. Right click to switch it on.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.facility_tablet.2: Pick a page from the contents on the left, or flip through with the arrows at the bottom. The home button jumps back to the start.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.facility_tablet.3: New here? Read Getting Started first. It shows how to charge redstone.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.fluid_dump.1: Pipe liquid into any side. Set in a dry basin or hole, the dump pours the liquid back out as source blocks, filling the hollow up to %s blocks around and %s blocks below it.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.fluid_dump.2: Sunk in water it lets out up to %s mB per second. Plain water simply mixes in. Lava hardens the surrounding water into cobblestone with a hiss.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.fluid_dump.3: Waste water and other foul liquids pollute the water around it. The murky patch spreads and darkens the longer you dump, dense pollution hurts anything swimming in it, and a small pond can turn into waste water altogether. Stop dumping and the water slowly clears.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.chunk_loader.1: A chunk loader keeps a square of chunks centred on its own chunk loaded and running while nobody is near: machines keep working, crops keep growing and furnaces keep smelting.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.chunk_loader.2: Open it to set the size with the plus and minus buttons. Radius 0 holds only its own chunk and each step adds a ring of chunks around it. This server allows up to radius %s, a %sx%s square.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.chunk_loader.3: It runs on SP through an outlet. It draws %s SP/t plus %s SP/t for every chunk it holds, so the cost climbs fast as the area grows: %s SP/t for one chunk, %s SP/t at radius 2, %s SP/t at radius 8 and %s SP/t at the largest size.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.chunk_loader.4: If the power runs short for a few seconds it lets go of all its chunks and waits for a steady supply before taking them back. Hold a chunk loader or open its screen to see the outline of its area.
Place it on a floor, wall or ceiling and give it a redstone signal to start the effect. It stops when the signal goes away.
Use the emitter with an empty hand to switch between its modes. Cold Floor fills the floor around it with a low, rolling blanket of cold fog, like dry ice spilling across a freezer room.
The fog spreads out to fill the room it is released into. Walls and closed doors hold it back, and it pours softly over ledges.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.trinitite_ore.1: Trinitite turns up in stone and deepslate about as often as iron, at the same depths. Mine it with an iron pickaxe or better.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.trinitite_ore.2: Each ore drops one or two Trinitite Shards and a little experience. Fortune adds more shards and Silk Touch keeps the ore whole. Smelting the ore gives one shard.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.trinitite_shard: Nine Trinitite Shards craft a Block of Trinitite, and the block crafts back into nine shards.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.trinitite_block.1: To charge it, place the block, mount an outlet on it and connect that outlet to a powered network. The block soaks up %s SP at up to %s SP/t, then turns into Charged Trinitite, just like a block of redstone turns into Charged Redstone.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.trinitite_block.2: A Charge Disperser touching the block charges it too. The disperser draws %s SP/t and shares it between every block it is charging.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.charged_trinitite: Two blocks of Charged Trinitite and one Copper Wire craft a block of Charged Redstone.
It gives off a faint light and throws the odd harmless spark.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.point_miner.1: Point Miners stack. Place them on top of each other and wire an outlet to the top of the topmost one. That single feed powers the whole stack.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.point_miner.2: Each miner in the stack draws %s SP/t. A stack that gets less than it asks for mines more slowly.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.point_miner.3: Every miner needs water piped into its back, about %s mB per minute while mining. A dry miner overheats and stops, but the rest of the stack keeps going.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.point_miner.4: At full power a miner makes %s points per minute and sends them to a Point Bank on its network. With no bank it holds %s points, then pauses.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.point_bank.1: Collects the points mined on its network. Spend them in the Shop app on any computer that reaches it.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.point_bank.2: It draws %s power. Several banks on one network pool their points, and the Shop spends from them in turn.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.point_bank.3: A broken bank keeps its points, so it can be moved to a new network.
jei.scp_unleashed.fission_tower_fuel.hea: %s heat/t per segment at full reaction
jei.scp_unleashed.fission_tower_fuel.tim: %s min per rod at full reaction
jei.scp_unleashed.fission_tower_fuel.gas: %s mB/s toxic gas at full reaction
jei.scp_unleashed.fission_tower_steam.co: Up to %s mB/t per segment, cools
jei.scp_unleashed.fission_tower_steam.ch: Up to %s mB/t per segment, no cooling
jei.scp_unleashed.info.fuel_tower.1: Fuel Towers are the heart of the modular fission reactor. Stack up to %s segments into a tower; each segment holds one fuel rod. Load rods by right-clicking or with a hopper, and take spent rods out with an empty hand or a hopper. Towers standing side by side form one reactor.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.fuel_tower.2: A fuel tower only reacts where a Control Rod Tower stands next to it, level by level. Reacting fuel makes heat and toxic gas. The gas leaves through the bottom of the tower: put a pressurized vent duct or a gas dissolver directly underneath, or it leaks out around the base.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.fuel_tower.3: Heat builds up unless Coolant Towers carry it away. Above %s °C the tower is hot and alarms sound. Above %s °C it starts to break down, and if it breaks completely it explodes and spills toxic gas. Pushing the rods in stops the reaction and lets it cool.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.control_rod_tower: Control Rod Towers let the fuel towers beside them react. Their rods start fully inserted, which stops the reaction. Pull them out with a Reactor Controller, or by hand: right-click pulls them out and sneak-right-click pushes them in.
Pulling rods out makes more heat and more steam but burns fuel faster. A redstone signal on the tower drops its rods all the way in.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.coolant_tower.1: Coolant Towers take heat from the fuel towers beside them and boil water into steam. Each segment carries away up to %s heat per tick, shared between every fuel tower it touches.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.coolant_tower.2: Pipe water into any side or the bottom. Steam leaves through vent ducts fitted to the top segment, on its top or its sides; send it on to steam turbines. A full tower blows its extra steam into the air, and without water it stops cooling.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.steam_channel.1: Steam Channels turn the heat of the fuel towers beside them into extra steam without cooling them, so those towers still need Coolant Towers on another side.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.steam_channel.2: They make the most steam when the fuel tower runs hot, around %s °C, which makes them strong but risky. Pipe water in like a Coolant Tower; steam leaves through vents on the top segment.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.reactor_controlle: The Reactor Controller shows a map of every tower in the reactor with its heat, fuel, water and steam. Link it by placing it against any tower, or sneak-use the controller item on a tower and then place it within %s blocks.

Select a control rod tower on the map to move its rods, move every rod at once, or press SCRAM to drop them all. A redstone signal into the controller holds every rod in, and a comparator reads the hottest fuel tower.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.irradiation_chamb: Place an Irradiation Chamber against a reacting Fuel Tower segment to transmute items, such as Energum Dust into Reactive Material. Every reacting segment touching it speeds it up.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.oil_extractor.1: A pumpjack for crude oil. Its wellhead must stand directly on bedrock; anywhere else it will not pump. While powered it lifts %s mB of crude oil every %s seconds.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.oil_extractor.2: It draws %s SP/t while pumping. Pull the oil off its wellhead flanges with pressurized pipes and send it to a distillation tower.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.distillation_towe: A 3x10x3 column that splits crude oil into light oil and heavy oil. Crude oil goes in at the back near the bottom.
Light oil leaves high on the left side and heavy oil low on the right side, so each fraction gets its own pipe.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.chemical_processo: Treats light oil into light fuel and heavy oil into heavy fuel. It holds one oil at a time, so give each fraction its own processor.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.combustion_genera: Burns light or heavy fuel into SP. Heavy fuel gives more power per bucket but makes more toxic gas. It holds %s SP.
Toxic gas leaves through the vent flange on top. Pipe it to a gas dissolver or a gas tank, or vent it far away; if the gas has nowhere to go the engine stalls.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.oil_refinery: Cracks light oil into plastic and gives back clean water. Hoppers can take the plastic from any of its blocks.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.oil: Thick black crude oil from bedrock. It clings to anyone wading through it.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.light_oil: The light fraction of crude oil. Make it into light fuel or plastic.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.heavy_oil: The heavy fraction of crude oil. It is sticky to wade through. Make it into heavy fuel.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.light_fuel: Clean-burning engine fuel for the combustion generator.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.heavy_fuel: Dense engine fuel: more power per bucket than light fuel, and more toxic gas.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.forcefield_emitte: Place one emitter on the floor and a matching one on the ceiling directly above it, up to %s blocks apart. While powered, the pair raises a hard energy barrier between them that stops people, creatures, anomalies and projectiles.
Pairs placed side by side join into one seamless wall of up to %s columns. The wall shares one barrier and one power feed, so an outlet on any floor emitter can run all of it.
Each column draws %s SP/t plus %s SP/t per barrier block. Without full power the barrier drops, and it comes back on its own once power returns.
The barrier cannot be mined. Gunfire, blows, arrows and blasts wear it down instead, and it slowly recovers when left alone.
Push it too far and the whole wall collapses. A collapsed wall stays down until someone uses a floor emitter or pulses it with redstone, which starts a reboot sequence.
jei.scp_unleashed.boiling.hint: Burns %s times as fast as a furnace. Steam turbines make %s SP from every mB of the steam.
jei.scp_unleashed.condensing.climate: Hot climates give back %s mB, cold ones %s mB
jei.scp_unleashed.info.water_boiler.1: A 3 by 4 by 3 boiler that burns any furnace fuel to boil water into steam, up to %s mB per second once it is hot. Pipe water into the sockets on its firebox and connect a pressurized vent duct to the collar on top of the drum or high on its back.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.water_boiler.2: The fire only burns while there is water to boil and room in the drum, so no fuel is wasted. Fed into steam turbines, a boiler gets far more power out of each piece of fuel than a heat generator does.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.steam_turbine.1: Turns steam from a vent duct into power: %s SP for every mB, up to %s SP/t. The more steam waits at its inlet, the faster it spins, so a stronger supply means more power.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.steam_turbine.2: Steam enters through the blue collars on top and every mB leaves through the orange collars on the back as low pressure steam. Vent it to a cooling tower to win the water back. If the exhaust has nowhere to go, the turbine backs up and slows down.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.cooling_tower.1: Condenses low pressure steam back into water, returning %s to %s%% of it. Cooler climates return more; the rest drifts off the top as vapour.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.cooling_tower.2: An 8 block tall tower. Vent steam into the blue intakes along the sides of its base and pipe the water out of the sumps on its front and back, straight back to your boilers. Top up the loss with a little fresh water.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.gas.low_pressure_: Low pressure steam is what is left once steam has driven a turbine. Released into the open it drifts away as faint wisps; a cooling tower turns most of it back into water.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp_sign.1: A placard two blocks wide that names the anomaly held behind a door. It shows the file photo, designation, title and object class, with a band in the class colour. It needs two free wall spaces side by side.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp_sign.2: Use an opened anomaly file or a database copy on the sign to post that subject. The file is not used up. Sneak and use the sign with an empty hand to clear it. A broken sign keeps its subject.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp_sign.3: A redstone signal turns on a soft backlight behind the glass.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp_sign_small.1: A compact one block placard for tight spots, such as above a narrow door. It shows the same file details in a smaller frame.
jei.scp_unleashed.sampling_needle: A fine steel needle on a small glass barrel. Hit another player with it to draw a sample. Each draw costs them half a heart and fills one empty Sample Vial from your inventory.
jei.scp_unleashed.sampling_needle.self: Sneak-use it to draw a sample from yourself instead, so you can clone yourself without help.
jei.scp_unleashed.sampling_needle.limits: Only players give a usable sample. Creatures and personnel give nothing, and players in creative or spectator mode can't be sampled. D-Class Blood is still made at the crafting table.
jei.scp_unleashed.player_blood_sample: A sealed vial holding one player's sample. Load it into a Cloning Machine to grow a clone of that player.
jei.scp_unleashed.player_blood_sample.cy: It grows like any other subject: %s seconds at full power, and the empty vial comes back out of the tray.
jei.scp_unleashed.player_blood_sample.cl: The clone wears the player's look and behaves like D-Class personnel. A Neural Controller can take it over, but it has no personnel file and no D-Class number.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.booster_tower.1: Booster Towers raise the reaction of fuel towers to spike power. A booster never works on fuel directly: stand it beside a Control Rod Tower and it boosts the fuel towers that rod tower covers, level by level. Placed straight against a fuel tower it does nothing.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.booster_tower.2: Each segment adds %s%% to the reaction, up to %s%% on any fuel level. A full boost roughly doubles the heat and steam of the fuel it reaches and burns that fuel twice as fast.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.booster_tower.3: Fully inserted rods block the booster completely. As the rods come out the boost passes through in proportion, on top of the reaction the rods already allow. SCRAM drops the rods and kills the spike. Boosted fuel needs far more cooling.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.rocket_platform.1: A launch pad for crewed rockets. Build it in the open: it needs clear sky straight above the pad. Stand a rocket on it and climb in.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.rocket_platform.2: Pick the destination with the arrows on its screen. Each destination has its own cost; a trip to the Moon burns %s mB of heavy fuel and %s SP.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.rocket_platform.3: Pipe heavy fuel into the flange on the front left corner and wire an outlet to the socket on the front right corner. Press Space while seated, or the launch button, to start the countdown.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.rocket.1: Built in the Advanced Assembler from two rocket engines and a lot of steel.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.rocket.2: Use it on a Rocket Platform to stand it up. Right click to climb in. Space launches when the pad is fuelled and charged; Shift gets you out while it is still on the pad.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.rocket.3: From Earth it flies to the destination picked on the platform; from anywhere else it flies home to where you launched from. You arrive in a drop pod: hold Space to slow down.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.rocket.4: Punch a landed pod to get the rocket back. Away from Earth the pod also gives you a portable launch pad and enough fuel for the trip home.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.portable_launch_p: Comes out of a drop pod that lands away from Earth. Place it, stand a rocket on it and climb in.
It needs no fuel or power, but only launches a rocket that carries its own fuel. Away from Earth it always flies home.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.satellite_platfor: A launch cradle for satellites. It needs clear sky straight above. Load a satellite into the cradle slot and press Launch.
Each launch burns %s mB of heavy fuel and %s SP. Pipe heavy fuel into the flange on the right side and wire an outlet to the socket on the left side.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.satellite.1: Load it into a Satellite Platform and press Launch. A small booster carries it out of sight and it stays in orbit.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.satellite.2: Rename it in an anvil to give it a name; otherwise it gets a number.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.rocket_engine: A rocket motor built in the Advanced Assembler. A rocket needs two and a satellite needs one.
jei.scp_unleashed.air_infusing.tooltip: Draws in the surrounding air. Speed upgrades fill faster but draw more power
jei.scp_unleashed.info.air_infuser.1: The Air Infuser compresses the surrounding air into Air Canisters. An empty canister fills in %s seconds while it draws %s SP/t.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.air_infuser.2: Wire it through an outlet on its sides, back or top. Hoppers feed empty canisters in and pull full ones out of the bottom. It has nothing to work with where there is no air.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.air_canister.1: A full Air Canister keeps a space suit breathing for about %s minutes. Fill it in an Air Infuser.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.air_canister.2: Wearing the space suit, right click with a filled canister to fit it. The canister that was fitted before comes back to you.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.space_suit.1: Wear all four pieces with air in the fitted canister to survive where there is no air. The suit only uses air out there.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.space_suit.2: A gauge above your hunger bar shows the canister. Your suit warns you when it runs low.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.space_suit_helmet: The gold visor keeps the sun out, at the cost of your view.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.space_suit_chestp: The life support pack holds one Air Canister.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.space_suit_leggin: Armoured knees for kneeling on rough ground.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.space_suit_boots: Weighted boots for walking in loose dust.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.lunar_dust: Fine grey dust that blankets the Moon. It slides and falls like sand.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.lunar_regolith: Packed, gravelly soil found under the lunar dust and around fresh craters.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.lunar_stone: The bedrock of the Moon's highlands. It can be polished and cut into bricks.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.earplugs.1: Foam earplugs on a cord. Wear them and almost every sound fades to a dull murmur.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.earplugs.2: Voices turn into indistinct mumbling while they are in. You will also miss anything that tries to warn you.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.blindfold.1: A strip of dark cloth. Tied over the eyes it leaves you with nothing but a faint glow through the weave.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.blindfold.2: You can still move and turn your head, you just cannot see. Out of sight is not always out of danger.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.senses.worn_head: Right click to wear it on your head.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.senses.worn_curio: Right click to wear it in its accessory slot, or put it on your head.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.network_hub.1: The Network Hub joins the network it is wired to. Place an outlet on one of the two copper ports at its base.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.network_hub.2: Every powered hub set to the same port links its network to the others. Computers, chat, message databases, upload ports, point banks, the archive database and wire signals such as redstone ports and speakers then work across them as one network, however far apart, even in other dimensions.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.network_hub.3: Hubs on different ports never talk. A link reaches the networks of hubs on the same port only, not hubs further along on other ports.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.network_hub.4: It needs %s SP/t. Without power, or when broken, its links drop at once.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.network_hub.5: If a linked hub's area is unloaded, archive database access keeps working, but live signals to it are dropped and counted in the panel. A hub never loads chunks by itself.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.magnetized_tall_b: A heavy bulkhead door of magnetized steel, 2 wide and 3 tall. It opens only while it receives a redstone signal and seals again when the signal stops.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.magnetized_single: A narrow bulkhead door of magnetized steel, 1 wide and 2 tall. It opens only while it receives a redstone signal and seals again when the signal stops.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.sentry_turret.1: A powered sentry gun that guards everything within %s blocks. Feed it SP through an outlet on its sides or back, and load firearm ammunition into its feed by hand, through the menu or with a hopper.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.sentry_turret.2: It idles on %s SP/t and draws up to %s SP/t while it tracks and fires. Each kind of round fires at its own pace, and without power it simply sleeps.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.sentry_turret.3: Pick what it shoots in the Targets tab, and list players or mobs to always allow or always deny in the Access tab. It never targets whoever placed it and holds fire when someone it must not hit stands in the way.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.motion_detector.1: A small sensor for walls and ceilings that watches a cone in front of its lens, %s blocks by default. When something moves, it sends a redstone signal on its port to every receiver on the same port, and powers the block it is mounted on.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.motion_detector.2: Wire it straight to a network with copper wire, then right click it to set its port, range, pulse or hold signal and what it reacts to. A slow and careful approach is harder for it to notice.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.cctv_camera.1: A security camera for walls and ceilings. Sneak and use a Camera Tablet on it to add it to the tablet's list.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.cctv_camera.2: Watched through a tablet, it pans up to %s degrees left and right and tilts up to %s degrees up and down.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.cctv_camera.3: Its red light blinks while it records and flashes faster while someone watches the feed.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.camera_tablet.1: Holds up to %s linked cameras. Use it to open the list, then click a camera to watch its feed.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.camera_tablet.2: While you watch, your body stays where it is. Look around with the mouse or movement keys, switch cameras with the arrow keys or the scroll wheel, and sneak or press Escape to leave.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.camera_tablet.3: A camera that no longer responds is dropped from the list when you try to open it. Getting hurt or putting the tablet away cuts the feed.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.rift_collector.1: A turret that finds open rifts within %s blocks, turns to face them and pulls them in the way a Rift Extractor would.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.rift_collector.2: It idles at %s SP/t. While pulling it draws %s SP/t for faint rifts, up to %s SP/t for abyssal ones. It needs a clear line of sight.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.rift_collector.3: Fragments land in a %s slot buffer that hoppers can empty from either half.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.rift_collector.4: Each Range Upgrade adds %s blocks, up to %s blocks.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.instability_pylon: Place four pylons on the corners of a rectangle, %s to %s blocks per side, all at the same height. When every corner is powered they link into an instability grid.
Stack a second rectangle %s to %s blocks above the first to build a box of eight.
A grid draws %s to %s SP/t, split between its corners, and forms rifts only inside its field. A rectangle holds up to %s rifts, a box up to %s.
Open any pylon to see the grid. If the layout is wrong, the screen points at the missing or dark corner.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.apocalyptic_rift_: Left behind when a golden rift is collected.
It can be read at the Archive like any fragment, but the Archive answers gold with files no common fragment can reach.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.range_upgrade.1: Install on a Rift Collector to extend its reach by %s blocks.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.invisible_ink.1: Invisible Ink hides a single wire span or an outlet. Right-click a wire or an outlet to hide it, and right-click it again to bring it back.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.invisible_ink.2: Hidden wiring works exactly as before. Wires still carry power and data, outlets still take new wires, and wire cutters still cut hidden spans. Jade still shows a hidden outlet when you look at it.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.invisible_ink.3: Hold the ink in either hand to see hidden wires and outlets as faint ghosts. A bottle holds %s dabs. Hiding uses one, showing again is free, and an empty bottle is left behind.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.disinfecting_wipe: A single-use disinfecting wipe. Hold use on any block to wipe it down, the way you would work a brush.
Every surface within %s blocks of the wiped block is cleaned, and anything growing on those surfaces dies.
It does nothing for people or for a contaminated suit. Wash those off under a drain.
Calls a Mobile Task Force squad by helicopter. Hold an unstable fragment in your other hand and use the radio. The fragment is spent when the signal goes out.
The landing zone needs open sky overhead. The helicopter hovers about %s blocks up while the squad fast-ropes down.
The fragment's grade decides who answers, from a %s-operative fireteam to a %s-operative detachment. Rarer grades bring heavier weapons, tougher armour and sharper soldiers.
Squads stay on station for %s to %s minutes. They fight whatever you are fighting and cover you from hostiles, then rope back up and leave. Only one squad answers you at a time.
Use the radio again for a status report, or sneak and use it to call the extraction early.
jei.scp_unleashed.dclass_manager: Use on a D-Class to open their duty sheet.
jei.scp_unleashed.dclass_manager.roles: A role is a standing job. A janitor keeps the area where it was assigned clean.
jei.scp_unleashed.dclass_manager.orders: Orders are one off jobs: eat or drink an item you hand over, follow you, or clean up around where they stand.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.patrol_node.1: Place Patrol Nodes where guards should walk or stand. A node faces the way you look when placing it, and a guard standing there faces the same way.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.patrol_node.2: Nodes only mark the route while you plan it. Guards keep walking the same route even if the nodes are removed later.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.patrol_manager.1: Use a Patrol Linker on the manager, then on Patrol Nodes in walking order. A route holds up to %s posts within %s blocks of the manager.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.patrol_manager.2: Open the manager to reorder posts, set how long guards wait at each one, choose a loop or back and forth, and set the rules of engagement.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.patrol_manager.3: Use Patrol Orders on the manager to write the route and rules onto them.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.patrol_linker.1: Use on a Patrol Manager to start linking, then use on Patrol Nodes in the order guards should walk them. Use a linked node again to remove it.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.patrol_linker.2: While held, the linked route is shown as numbered posts joined by lines.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.patrol_orders.1: Write orders at a Patrol Manager, then use them on a D-Class to make them a guard. One copy can be handed to several D-Class.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.patrol_orders.2: Guards walk the route, wait at each post and deal with threats by the rules they were given. A route with one post means standing guard there.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.patrol_orders.3: Use blank orders on a guard, or sneak and use written orders, to take them off duty. Guards carry their own weapons, ammunition, keycards and armour.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.serpents_hand_sta: A stasis capsule carried by agents of the Serpent's Hand.
A filled pod holds a living anomaly. Right-click a block to let it out.
The capsule breaks open when it is used.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.micro_hid.1: The Micro H.I.D. is a heavy tesla projector assembled at the Gun Bench. It fires one continuous electrical beam instead of single shots.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.micro_hid.2: Hold use to spin it up. After %s seconds the coils discharge and the beam keeps firing for as long as you hold on. Let go and it winds down.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.micro_hid.3: The beam deals %s damage %s times a second to every creature along its path and around the point it strikes, out to %s blocks. Solid blocks stop it and it never breaks terrain.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.micro_hid.4: It runs on a stored charge. A full charge fires for about %s seconds, spinning up costs charge too, and an empty Micro H.I.D. only clicks.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.micro_hid.5: It is heavy: you move slowly while it fires. Recharge it on a Micro Charging Platform.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.micro_charging_pl: A powered dock for the Micro H.I.D.
It draws %s SP/t from the power network while a docked Micro H.I.D. charges, and fills an empty one in about %s seconds. Wire it through an outlet on its back.
Use a Micro H.I.D. on the platform to dock it and use the platform with an empty hand to take it back. The lights on its front show the charge, and a broken platform drops the docked gun.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.industrial_turbin: A 3 by 2 by 6 turbine for big plants. It makes %s SP from every mB of steam, up to %s SP/t, and takes steam through three separate inlets on top, up to %s mB a second each.

Give every inlet its own vent line and every orange exhaust collar on the back its own way out, best into a cooling tower. Its heavy rotor takes %s seconds to come up to full speed and keeps turning for a while after the steam stops.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.facility_sign_hea: A header banner three blocks wide that goes over a gate. Place it on the middle block above the gate and it reaches one block to each side. It can also hang from a ceiling, readable from both sides.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.facility_sign.1: A wayfinding sign two blocks wide in a gunmetal frame. It mounts on a wall or hangs from a ceiling on two rods, where both sides can be read. It needs two free spaces side by side.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.facility_sign.2: Use it with an empty hand to turn the arrow right, down, left, up or off. Sneak to turn it back.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.facility_sign.3: Every facility sign and plaque is made at the Decorations Workbench.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.facility_sign_sma: A one block wayfinding plaque in a gunmetal frame for doors and tight spots. It mounts on a solid wall.
